title: Hearty Venezuelan Pasta
description: A quick and flavorful Venezuelan dish featuring pomegranate molasses and a unique pasta water emulsion, this kosher friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium high heat.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground beef to the skillet, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once the beef is browned, add the cumin and cook for one minute.
Stir in the pomegranate molasses and cook for an additional minute.
Reserve one cup of pasta water before draining the pappardelle.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine with the beef and onion mixture.
Add the reserved pasta water to the skillet in small increments, tossing to create a creamy emulsion.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
